selection.forget: First 15 unique texts in the Llama RMU forget prefix (shuffled with seed 42, then min_len=50 / max_len=2000, then the first min(forget_batches, retain_batches, 150) batches at batch_size=8). selection.retain: First 15 unique texts in the shared Wikipedia retain list after the same seed-42 shuffle and RMU length filter. This ordered list is identical across concepts because every concept has 300 forget sentences, so shuffle(forget) leaves the RNG in the same state before shuffle(retain).

notes: Checkpoints do not store sample lists; this file reconstructs them from code + seed + data.
PISCES does not consume forget/retain sentences (SAE feature edits only), so it does not constrain the set.
SNMF/EMBER unlearning applies precomputed features. Feature extraction used all 300 concept + all 300 Wikipedia neutrals (train_mf_features hardcodes data/neutral_sentences.json).
RMU is the bottleneck: it drops texts shorter than 50 chars and stops when either forget or retain batches run out (retain is shorter, so some forget texts are unused).
